reviews.review:
This game has some solid platforming and cool environments and enemy variety. I also thought the quest system was good as well. The voice acting is pretty good too and I appreciate the weapon variety.

However the combat is atrocious. It feels so stiff and like I can't even react to an enemy. Doing your weapon combo practically freezes your character in place for a second. I feel like I should be able to animation cancel an attack to do a dodge or parry but I can't. Not sure if this was an intentional design choice or not but it's not great. Also in a platformer I'm unsure why my character can't grab onto ledges. Seems like an oversight. 

This game has solid bones I think it just needs to cook a little longer.
reviews.developer_response:
Hey, apologies for your experience. On the combat improvements, we hear you and plan to implement some improvements on the attack combos to increase the fluidity as well. We hope you can try it in the future when this is implemented.

Thanks for trying out our game and sharing your experience. It's very helpful to see where the game isn't landing for some players.
